variants.title: Torsional pendulum: rigidity modulus of a steel wire (SWG 20)
variants.method: Torsional oscillations of a brass disc
variants.unknown: the modulus of rigidity of steel
variants.note: Steel is the stiffest of these wires: the same disc oscillates fastest on it.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, elastic constants of metals (shear modulus of steel 79.3 GPa); BS 3737 standard wire gauge: SWG 20 = 0.914 mm

variants.title: Torsional pendulum: rigidity modulus of a brass wire (SWG 20)
variants.method: Torsional oscillations of a brass disc
variants.unknown: the modulus of rigidity of brass
variants.note: Brass has less than half the rigidity of steel, so the period is longer.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, elastic constants of metals (shear modulus of brass 36.5 GPa); BS 3737 standard wire gauge: SWG 20 = 0.914 mm

variants.title: Torsional pendulum: rigidity modulus of a copper wire (SWG 20)
variants.method: Torsional oscillations of a brass disc
variants.unknown: the modulus of rigidity of copper
variants.note: Copper sits between brass and steel. Keep the twist small: copper is soft and takes a set easily.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, elastic constants of metals (shear modulus of copper 44.7 GPa); BS 3737 standard wire gauge: SWG 20 = 0.914 mm

variants.title: Torsional pendulum: rigidity modulus of an aluminium wire (SWG 20)
variants.method: Torsional oscillations of a brass disc
variants.unknown: the modulus of rigidity of aluminium
variants.note: The softest wire of the set: the slowest oscillation, and the easiest to overstrain.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, elastic constants of metals (shear modulus of aluminium 26.0 GPa); BS 3737 standard wire gauge: SWG 20 = 0.914 mm

variants.title: Torsional pendulum: steel wire of a thinner gauge (SWG 22)
variants.method: Torsional oscillations of a brass disc
variants.unknown: the modulus of rigidity of steel
variants.note: The same steel drawn thinner. The radius comes in as r to the fourth, so the period is much longer.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, elastic constants of metals (shear modulus of steel 79.3 GPa); BS 3737 standard wire gauge: SWG 22 = 0.711 mm

variants.title: Torsional pendulum: steel wire of the thinnest gauge (SWG 24)
variants.method: Torsional oscillations of a brass disc
variants.unknown: the modulus of rigidity of steel
variants.note: Thinner again: the oscillation is slow enough to count comfortably, but the wire is easily overstrained.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, elastic constants of metals (shear modulus of steel 79.3 GPa); BS 3737 standard wire gauge: SWG 24 = 0.559 mm
